_: Hand-confirmed links that the automatic matching misses or gets wrong. same: catalog item id -> library book id. different: pairs the matcher must not join. volumes: item id -> volume number, for series whose titles carry no numbering. translations: pairs of works (ids or /book/ slugs) where one translates the other. covers: work (id or /book/ slug) -> the cover to show, when the edition picked for the work has a worse one.
